c9e5bedb0e226be9200d97478eafe2aabf806b9d.pinyin: yuán dīng shān chú zá cǎo, zhěng lǐ huā pǔ.
c9e5bedb0e226be9200d97478eafe2aabf806b9d.text: 园丁芟除杂草，整理花圃。

c9e77ecf65bd22574b1cfc798e8cf968c95bebfb.pinyin: zhè liǎng jiā diàn de jià gé bù tóng.

c9ee9b12b04cfb7c0d4ea790697ae897cb0541f0.pinyin: tā xǐ huān yán jiū qí pǔ, zhōu mò zuò shàng yī tiān yě lè cǐ bù pí.
c9ee9b12b04cfb7c0d4ea790697ae897cb0541f0.text: 他喜欢研究棋谱，周末坐上一天也乐此不疲。

c9f3774c77d368b203bbd191919279b1eb8895e7.pinyin: liǎng zhǐ yuān yāng yóu guò, shuǐ miàn fàn qǐ yuán quān.
c9f3774c77d368b203bbd191919279b1eb8895e7.text: 两只鸳鸯游过，水面泛起圆圈。

c9f8c5fce3dcd6b7140ad2db4df3b352339bb7f4.pinyin: zhǎn bǎn jiè shào le xiān jiào de lì shǐ.
c9f8c5fce3dcd6b7140ad2db4df3b352339bb7f4.text: 展板介绍了祆教的历史。

c9fb797d7f43f2bb9ced42e019268d0d0cf05d69.pinyin: tīng dào zhǔ rén de shēng yīn, mǎ kāi shǐ sī míng.
c9fb797d7f43f2bb9ced42e019268d0d0cf05d69.text: 听到主人的声音，马开始嘶鸣。

c9fc1d0c1a9a5712c5c38b2bc28b52e5656fbe93.pinyin: zhè kuài niú pái qiē chéng le xiǎo kuài.

c9fefe4d4768b02d12cc440954e24a28f2c1c320.pinyin: xiāng jiāng cóng cháng shā chéng zhōng liú guò.
